definitions.explanation: A system where people who arrive or apply first are given priority.

examples.japanese: チケットは{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}で{販売|はんばい}される。
examples.english: Tickets will be sold on a first-come, first-served basis.

examples.japanese: {先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}100{名|めい}に{プレゼント|ぷれぜんと}があります。
examples.english: The first 100 people will receive a gift.

examples.japanese: {予約|よやく}は{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}ですので、お{早|はや}めに。
examples.english: Reservations are first-come, first-served, so please hurry.

notes:
FORMATION:
{先着|せんちゃく} (arriving first) + {順|じゅん} (order)

GRAMMAR PATTERNS:
・{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}で - on a first-come, first-served basis
・{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}に - in order of arrival

COLLOCATIONS:
・{先着|せんちゃく}〜{名|めい} - first ~ people
・{先着|せんちゃく}〜{名|めい}{様|さま}{限定|げんてい} - limited to first ~ customers
・{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}で{受|う}け{付|つ}ける - to accept on a first-come basis

CONTRAST:
・{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん} - first-come, first-served
・{抽選|ちゅうせん} - lottery
・{予約制|よやくせい} - reservation system
